findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - a developer checks out a teammate's published fix branch in the primary checkout, then its pull request is squash-merged elsewhere. If the developer made no local commit, the branch's first reflog entry still equals HEAD, so lines 145–147 exclude it before comparing its tree with main. Ordinary commands pass `all_prs=False` (`src/forge/cli.py:175`), so `forge lanes --json` does not discover the merged pull request or list the primary checkout it keeps, even after main is fetched. The filter at line 151 also omits closed pull requests with deleted or advanced remote branches when their local changes are not in main. `forge doctor` uses `all_prs=True` and does list those cases.
